Commentary.Commentary: Right then, the first game is done and it is India Women who have kept their semi-final hopes well and truly alive. In the next game of the day, two winning teams, Australia Women and Barbados Women clash at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). Our build-up though will begin much sooner. The winner of that game will move on to 4 points and take an outright lead in Group A at the end of the second round of fixtures. See you then. Cheers!

Earlier in the game, Bismah Maroof won the toss and opted to bat under overcast conditions. This did not prove to be the best decision and even though Muneeba Ali and Bismah Maroof put on a good second-wicket partnership, their batting order just collapsed as soon as those two got out. The Indian spinners dominated with Sneh Rana controlling the middle overs well and Sneh Rana ending things off well too. With a low target to chase down and having already lost a game, India Women openers came out all guns blazing and Smriti Mandhana just took the game away from the opposition with a blistering knock of 63* off just 42 balls to seal the victory.

Pakistan Women had their work cut out with the ball but after a decent first couple of overs, their bowlers were put to the sword by Smriti Mandhana. They were defending a low score and needed wickets up top but that never happened. Diana Baig bowled well at the start and Omaima Sohail was more than useful with her off-spinners, picking up a wicket as well. Tuba Hassan too got a wicket but other than that there were no positives with the ball for them. Pakistan Women have been handed a huge defeat here and with their net run rate taking a hit, their chances of making it to the knockouts have almost completely perished.

At the innings interval, India Women would have been very happy with their bowling and fielding efforts and their batting has matched that as well. Needing just 100 runs to win in 108 deliveries, Smriti Mandhana was aggressive from the get-go and Shafali Verma too started briskly. The pair scored 50 plus runs inside the Powerplay and the back of the chase was broken then and there. Verma fell but Mandhana went on to score her third T20I Fifty and remained unbeaten in the end.

Smriti Mandhana with a power-packed innings and India Women have made short work of this chase, winning the game with 38 balls to spare. With this big victory, India Women have got right back in the mix for the knockouts. As for Pakistan Women, they are all but out of the competition.

FOUR! A massive victory for India. Smriti Mandhana wraps things up with a boundary. It is full and on off. Mandhana slogs it over mid-wicket and finds a boundary. INDIA WOMEN WIN THE GAME BY 8 WICKETS.
Fuller, on off, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to cover for one.
Full and straight, Rodrigues jams it back towards the bowler.
Length ball, around off, this is swung away towards deep mid-wicket for one by Mandhana.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Smriti Mandhana steps out, makes it into a full toss and drives it through covers for one.
On the pads, Jemimah Rodrigues turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Jemimah Rodrigues is in next.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Omaima Sohail with a lovely piece of bowling and Sabbhineni Meghana walks back. Flights it up nicely, on a length and around off. Meghana steps down the track but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball as she looks to slog it away. The ball turns in and goes on to shatter the stumps. A consolation wicket here for Sohail who has bowled pretty well.
Fired in full and wide, Meghana swings at it but makes no connection.

Uppish but in the gap! Short and wide, Sabbhineni Meghana rocks back to cut but gets it off the outside edge. The ball goes past backward point but Fatima Sana chases it down and keeps it to a couple of runs.
This is slower and shorter, well outside off, Meghana reaches out and taps it towards point.
Does well the bowler there. This is full and around off, Mandhana punches it back sweetly to the right of the bowler. Fatima Sana sticks out her right boot and makes a stop.
Sana takes all the pace off the ball and bowls it full and wide. Sabbhineni Meghana reaches forward and drives it towards deep cover for a run.
Full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana backs away and drives it through covers again, just for a single though.
Sana switches to over the wicket and goes wide of the crease, trying to angle in a yorker. Sana serves a full toss which Sabbhineni Meghana eases down the ground for only a single.
Full and outside off, nicely driven through cover for a single.
Around off, nudged away towards short third man. Mandhana wants the single but is sent back by her partner. Mandhana puts her bat down in time as the fielder scores a direct hit at the batter's end.
FOUR! Back-to-back! Floated up outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana uses her feet well and chips it right back over the bowler's head. No chance for the long on fielder as the placement is perfect.
FOUR! Sabbhineni Meghana releases the pressure with that shot. Tossed up, outside off, Meghana dances down the track and thumps it over extra cover for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, Sabbhineni Meghana uses her feet and just pushes it gently towards mid off.
Full and outside off, pushed away towards cover.
Good length, outside off, this is cut away off the back foot to deep point for one.

THREE WIDES! Round-arm delivery, Mandhana moves across the stumps but it is floated well beyond the tramline outside off. The keeper fails to collect as the ball trickles down to third man. The batters get back for two with ease.
Fuller and quicker, well outside off, Mandhana moves across the off stump and has a dab at it but misses.
Full and straight, Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it out. 24 needed now off 60 balls.
On a length and around off, Mandhana hops back and plays it late towards short third man for one.
Switches to around the wicket now and angles it in from outside off. Mandhana taps it towards point.

SIX! FIFTY for Smriti Mandhana and what an explosive knock this has been! This is tossed up on middle, Mandhana steps down the track and launches it high and handsome over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Flatter, around middle, nudged away to the leg side for a run.

TWO BYES! Flighted, on a nagging length and well outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana has a big swing at it but misses and the extra bounce beats the keeper as well. The batters come back for a couple of byes.
WIDE! Flatter and doing leg, Meghana looks to sweep but misse. Wide called.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Fuller, around off, Smriti Mandhana looks to push it away but does so inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper's head. The batters take two.
Tossed up, on off. Meghana tucks it to mid on for a single.
Full, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it out on the front foot.
Flatter, on off. Mandhana pushes it to mid off for a single.
Another bowling change as Omaima Sohail comes on to bowl.
Shorter and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana gets behind the line to make the block.
Sabbhineni Meghana is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shafali Verma's innings comes to an end, but the job is half done. Tuba Hassan finds the crucial breakthrough and have got life back into the Pakistani fans at Edgbaston. Slower delivery, flatter and short outside off. Verma tries to cut it away but only manages to get an outside edge. Muneeba Ali makes no mistake behind the sticks. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises her dreaded finger.
Commentary.Howout: c Muneeba Ali b Tuba Hassan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! It is tossed up, around middle. Shafali Verma heaves it across the line against the spin. It goes over the infield and races away to the boundary at deep mid-wicket.
Around off, Mandhana gets back and punches it to point. The fielder fumbles and the batters take a single.
FOUR! Deft touch! This is incredible batting on display by Mandhana! It is tossed up, just outside off. Smriti Mandhana waits for it and guides it down to third man for a fine boundary.
Flatter one outside off. Mandhana cuts it to point but not in the gap.
Tuba Hassan to have a bowl now.
Length ball, on off, Mandhana drives it to long off for one. 11 runs off the over. India Women have already eaten up more than half of the target.
SIX! BANG! 52 up for India in no time. It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana comes down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
A slower length ball, around off. Mandhana pushes it to mid off.

FOUR! The boundaries continue to flow no matter who the bowler is! It is a short ball, on the bodyline. Smriti Mandhana swivels on the back foot and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a cracking boundary.
Good length, around off. Mandhana comes down the track and eases it to covers.
Full length, angled across, around off. Smriti Mandhana stays back and punches it to cover.
FOUR! 16 off the over and India Women taking full advantage of the Powerplay! Tossed up, outside off, Shafali Verma stands tall and thrashes it over wide mid off for another boundary.
Quicker and flatter, around off, Mandhana plays it late and down to third man for a single.
This is fired in outside off, Mandhana leaves it alone.

FOUR! A bit streaky this time but Mandhana won't mind. This is outside off, Mandhana advances again and looks to go over extra cover but is beaten a bit in flight, The ball loops up off the outside half of the bat and goes over backward point for a boundary.
Misses out this time. Full toss, fired in on leg stump, Verma can only manage to hit it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Huge hit! Tossed up on a length and on off, Shafali Verma stays put and muscles it well over the long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Mandhana is in a hurry out there. This is full and wide, Mandhana advances and just opens the face of the bat to guide it past backward point for yet another boundary.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana toying with the field here. Short of a length, on off. Mandhana shuffles a bit and pulls it towards deep square leg from where the fielder was moved on the last delivery. The ball goes one-bounce into the fence.
Swing and a miss! Baig takes some pace off the ball and delivers it full and wide. Mandhana looks to hit through the line again but is well beaten.
A touch fuller and around off, driven towards mid off.
FOUR! Up and over! Overpitched, outside off, Smriti Mandhana hits through the line and lofts it over extra cover for another boundary.
Length ball, on the pads, this is tucked away round the corner for a single. Verma is off the mark!
FOUR! Easy pickings! A juicy full toss, around off, Mandhana takes a step or two towards the bowler and hammers it right back over a head for a boundary.
Around off, driven on the up but straight to the cover fielder.
Keeps it very full and on off, Mandhana pushes it back towards the bowler.
Very full, around off, this is driven straight to cover.
SIX! Smriti Mandhana on the attack right away! Tossed up, around off, Mandhana shuffles a bit and slogs it flat and hard over the long on fence for a maximum.
Starts off with a full delivery, around off, it is nicely driven towards cover-point.
Anam Amin to operate from the opposite end.
In the air but safe! This is full and angling into middle and leg. Shafali Verma looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge that loops up over the bowler's head.
Very full and on off, with a hint of away swing. Verma clips it towards mid-wicket.

Half an appeal for LBW but it is given as runs. Length again, on leg stump and swinging into the pads. Mandhana advances and looks to heave it across. The ball takes the inside edge and rolls onto the off side. They get a run.
Goes fuller and on off, this is pushed away towards mid off.
Good length, outside off, Smriti Mandhana hangs back and taps it towards point.

LEG BYE! Diana Baig starts off with a length delivery, around off and there's a bit of inward movement. Shafali Verma gets caught on the crease and the ball goes off the pads. The keeper lets it through and the batters get a leg bye. The ball went agonizingly close to the helmet as well.
